footprint_adaptation.authority: Owner ruling 2026-09-07 (Array Foundry): adapt the proportion to the footprint; do not change navigation or placement rules to match a drawing's apparent proportion.
footprint_adaptation.recorded_as: a footprint-driven adaptation, not a concept deviation to be silently absorbed
footprint_adaptation.what: The plinth is held to 300 cm across corners.
footprint_adaptation.what_the_matching_ratios_do_NOT_establis: Owner clarification 2026-09-07: the plinth-height / total-height ratio matching the trace (0.175 against 0.176) says nothing about plinth WIDTH against shaft width. Those are different measurements. The height ratio is met; the width proportion is adapted, and no agreement on the first may be read as agreement on the second.
footprint_adaptation.why: The traced plinth-to-shaft proportion would put it near 500 cm across, outside the 400 cm footprint.

material_slot_policy: Three slots: vitrified stone for the spire and apex, a worn stone for the plinth steps, and Magenta Fracture for the arris lines and the diamond register.

rig.policy: Root, the spire and its apex. The drift is the faction's reality-bleed device, NOT a canon motion clause for this building. No root motion.

scale_basis.aura_is_not_geometry: The 700 cm field is gameplay data projected as VFX from Field_Ring_Origin.

stage_boundary: Editable source and review evidence only. Not a gate pass, not an Unreal integration, not owner acceptance.

state_read.mechanism: field_lost moves every arris and register line into the vitrified slot, so the lit read is a slot change and not a brightness parameter. The register is the geometry that carries it; LOD1 keeps the two silhouette arrises so the read survives.

states.destroyed: PROPOSED DESTRUCTION STUDY: the spire snaps into a stump and two sections. Owner clarification 2026-09-07: the placement ruling does NOT require cosmetic debris to stay inside the footprint; the controlling concern is navigation, selection and gameplay readability. Segmentation is neither mechanically mandatory nor concept-approved - the candidate has no destroyed panel.
states.field_active: arrises and register lit; the aura ring is projected from Field_Ring_Origin
states.field_lost: arrises and register dark; the spire reads as inert stone
